subject: Independence Day Celebration - Montessori
body:
SCHOOL NAME REDACTED
 
Cir No:34/MONT/2026-27    15 August 2026
 
Dear Parents,
As part of the Independence Day celebrations in our Montessori section on 19th August, we request you to send your child dressed in any ethnic outfit in the tricolour theme (saffron, white, or green).
A gentle reminder that 19th August will also be a Bagless Day. Kindly send your child with only their snacks bag.
We look forward to celebrating this special occasion with our little ones! 🇮🇳
Warm regards,
[REDACTED]
Headmistress Montessori
